source_change: Use an immutable byte displacement, masked with 7, and derive each lane offset from displacement+i*2 or displacement+i*4. This replaces the widened mutable displacement induction variable in cases 8 and 9 of both native helpers.
assembly_basis: Original cases8/9 perform MOV CL,AL; AND CL,7; MOVZX ESI/EDI,CL before deriving indexed addresses. The previous source zero-extended first, masked ECX and carried a widened induction variable. The immutable-byte indexed source reproduces the complete four case blocks.

sites.cause: SHR EBX,11 moves around two register-copy instructions.
AND ECX,7 moves around the penultimate vector store.

remaining_store_cause: The candidate retains address&15 in EBX and spills the transpose register group; the original retains the register group in EBX and spills address&15. This creates repeated reloads and a different final alignment-condition schedule. No workaround is applied.

behavior.method: Original PE and independently compiled x86 bodies executed in separate Unicorn memory images. All32 kinds,16 elements,8 vector/address/signed-offset patterns, distinct argument/global opcodes. Compared17408bytes of RSP state/SPmemory, callee-saved registers and stack balance. Test-only relocation to separate execution addresses; no executable file modified.
